findingKind.description: Use service_unavailable for a proven stopped/disabled service blocking operation, incomplete_installation for proven absent required installation components, configuration_mismatch for other proven configuration/contract mismatches, no_current_fault_proven for established latest successful checks with no demonstrated current failure, and undetermined when failed/incomplete checks or unresolved ordering of conflicting failure/success evidence for the same operation/endpoint/target prevent determining the alleged condition. Missing metadata or broader health checks do not invalidate an otherwise demonstrated specific cause.

mechanismProven.description: True only if the immediate mechanism of the investigated system problem is demonstrated; an explanation for a failed diagnostic query does not establish that mechanism.

file.description: Exact source filename or absolute file path only; do not append line numbers, offsets or commentary.

quote.description: One verbatim contiguous excerpt from that source file. No paraphrases, ellipses or combined nonadjacent excerpts.
